sentences.zh: 小和鈸，制與鈸同，面徑七寸九分。

translations.literal: Small harmony cymbals are constructed the same as cymbals; face diameter seven cun nine fen.
translations.idiomatic: Small harmony cymbals follow the standard cymbal design, with a face seven cun and nine fen in diameter.

sentences.zh: 中隆起，穿孔貫紃，均與鈸同。

translations.literal: The center rises; holes are pierced and cords threaded through; all the same as cymbals.
translations.idiomatic: The domed center, pierced holes, and cord threading all match the standard cymbal.

sentences.zh: 花匡鼓，即腰鼓，木匡冒革，面徑一尺五寸二分，匡高一尺六寸，繪花文。

translations.literal: Flower-frame drums, that is waist drums, have wooden frames covered with hide; face diameter one chi five cun two fen, frame height one chi six cun, painted with floral patterns.
translations.idiomatic: Flower-frame drums—the waist drum—have wooden frames covered with hide; the head is one chi, five cun, and two fen in diameter, the frame one chi and six cun high, painted with floral designs.

sentences.zh: 座以檀，四柱交趺，以銅鐶懸鼓而擊之。

translations.literal: The base is sandalwood; four pillars with crossed feet; the drum is suspended by copper rings and struck.
translations.idiomatic: A sandalwood stand with four crossed pillars supports it; copper rings suspend the drum for striking.

sentences.zh: 得勝鼓，木匡冒革，面徑一尺六寸一分，匡高五寸八分，繪雲龍。

translations.literal: Victory drums have wooden frames covered with hide; face diameter one chi six cun one fen, frame height five cun eight fen, painted with cloud-and-dragon patterns.
translations.idiomatic: Victory drums have wooden frames covered with hide—the head one chi, six cun, and one fen in diameter, the frame five cun and eight fen high, painted with cloud-and-dragon designs.

sentences.zh: 座為四柱，懸鼓於上而擊之。

translations.literal: The base has four pillars; the drum is suspended above and struck.
translations.idiomatic: A four-pillared stand suspends the drum above for striking.

sentences.zh: 海笛，制如金口角而小，通長九寸五分。

translations.literal: Sea flutes are constructed like gold-mouthed horns but smaller; total length nine cun five fen.
translations.idiomatic: Sea flutes follow the gold-mouthed horn design but smaller—nine cun and five fen long overall.

sentences.zh: 凱歌用雲鑼四，方響八，鈸二，大和鈸二，星二，銅點二，鐋二，簫四，笛四，管十二，笙四，杖鼓二，拍板二。

translations.literal: Victory Song uses four cloud gongs, eight square chime sets, two cymbals, two large harmony cymbals, two xing, two copper dots, two tang, four xiao, four di, twelve guan pipes, four sheng, two stick drums, two clapper boards.
translations.idiomatic: Victory song music employs four cloud gongs, eight square chime sets, two cymbals, two large harmony cymbals, two xing, two copper dots, two tang, four xiao, four di, twelve guan pipes, four sheng, two stick drums, and two clapper boards.

sentences.zh: 簫、笛、笙同中和韶樂，雲鑼、管、杖鼓同丹陛大樂，鈸、銅點同鐃歌大樂。

translations.literal: Xiao, di, and sheng are the same as in Zhonghe Shao Music; cloud gongs, guan pipes, and stick drums are the same as in Danbi Grand Music; cymbals and copper dots are the same as in Nao Song Grand Music.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao, di, and sheng match Zhonghe Shao Music; cloud gongs, guan pipes, and stick drums match Danbi Grand Music; cymbals and copper dots match Nao Song Grand Music.

sentences.zh: 方響，制同丹陛大樂，分用其八，人各一枚，擎而擊之。

translations.literal: Square chimes are constructed the same as in Danbi Grand Music; eight of them are distributed for use, each person one piece, held aloft and struck.
translations.idiomatic: Square chimes follow the Danbi Grand Music design; eight are distributed so each player holds one aloft and strikes it.

sentences.zh: 大和鈸，制與鈸同，面徑一尺一寸八分。

translations.literal: Large harmony cymbals are constructed the same as cymbals; face diameter one chi one cun eight fen.
translations.idiomatic: Large harmony cymbals follow the standard cymbal design, with a face one chi, one cun, and eight fen in diameter.

sentences.zh: 中隆起，穿孔貫紃，左右合擊。

translations.literal: The center rises; holes are pierced and cords threaded through; struck together left and right.
translations.idiomatic: The center is domed; cords pass through pierced holes, and the pair is clashed together.

sentences.zh: 星，范銅為之，口徑一寸八分，深一寸。

translations.literal: Xing are cast from copper; mouth diameter one cun eight fen, depth one cun.
translations.idiomatic: Xing are cast in copper—the mouth one cun and eight fen across, one cun deep.

sentences.zh: 中隆起，各穿圓孔，貫以紃，左右合擊。

translations.literal: The center rises; each is pierced with a round hole; cords are threaded through; struck together left and right.
translations.idiomatic: Each has a domed center and a round pierced hole for cords; the pair is clashed together.

sentences.zh: 鐋，范銅為之，面徑二寸七分，口徑三寸一分五釐，深六分。

translations.literal: Tang are cast from copper; face diameter two cun seven fen, mouth diameter three cun one fen five li, depth six fen.
translations.idiomatic: Tang are cast in copper—the face two cun and seven fen in diameter, the mouth three cun, one fen, and five li across, six fen deep.

sentences.zh: 穿孔貫紃，擊以木片。

translations.literal: Holes are pierced and cords threaded through; struck with wooden slats.
translations.idiomatic: Cords pass through pierced holes; it is struck with wooden slats.

sentences.zh: 拍板三片，束其二，以一拍之。

translations.literal: Clapper boards have three slats; two are bound together, and one is used to strike them.
translations.idiomatic: Clapper boards have three slats—two bound together and one used to strike them.

sentences.zh: 禾辭桑歌樂，親耕、親桑用之。

translations.literal: Grain Ode and Mulberry Song Music is used for personal plowing and personal sericulture.
translations.idiomatic: Grain Ode and Mulberry Song Music accompanies the emperor's personal plowing and sericulture rites.

sentences.zh: 親耕用金六，鼓六，簫六，笛六，笙六，拍板六。

translations.literal: For personal plowing: six jin, six drums, six xiao, six di, six sheng, six clapper boards.
translations.idiomatic: Personal plowing uses six jin, six drums, six xiao, six di, six sheng, and six clapper boards.

sentences.zh: 親桑用金二，鼓二，簫、笛、笙各六，拍板二。

translations.literal: For personal sericulture: two jin, two drums, six each of xiao, di, and sheng, two clapper boards.
translations.idiomatic: Personal sericulture uses two jin, two drums, six each of xiao, di, and sheng, and two clapper boards.

sentences.zh: 簫、笛、笙同中和韶樂，板同丹陛大樂。

translations.literal: Xiao, di, and sheng are the same as in Zhonghe Shao Music; clapper boards are the same as in Danbi Grand Music.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao, di, and sheng match Zhonghe Shao Music; clapper boards match Danbi Grand Music.

sentences.zh: 金制同鐃歌鼓吹而微小。

translations.literal: Jin are constructed the same as in Nao Song Drum-and-Pipe Music but smaller.
translations.idiomatic: The jin follows the nao song drum-and-pipe design but in a smaller size.

sentences.zh: 槌用黃韋，瓜形，柄魨硃。

translations.literal: Mallets use yellow leather, gourd-shaped; handles lacquered vermilion.
translations.idiomatic: Mallets are yellow leather, gourd-shaped, with vermilion-lacquered handles.

sentences.zh: 鼓，制如龍鼓而微小，懸於項擊之。

translations.literal: Drums are constructed like dragon drums but smaller; hung at the neck and struck.
translations.idiomatic: Drums follow the dragon drum design but smaller, hung from the neck and struck.

sentences.zh: 慶神歡樂，凡群祀用之。

translations.literal: Joyous Celebration of the Spirits Music is used for all group sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Joyous Celebration of the Spirits Music accompanies all collective sacrificial rites.

sentences.zh: 其器雲鑼二，管二，笛二，笙一，鼓一，拍板一，惟祀先蠶及關帝、文昌則加隆焉。

translations.literal: Its instruments: two cloud gongs, two guan pipes, two di, one sheng, one drum, one clapper board; only for sacrifices to the Silkworm Goddess and to Guandi and Wenchang are additions made.
translations.idiomatic: Its instruments are two cloud gongs, two guan pipes, two di, one sheng, one drum, and one clapper board—except for rites to the Silkworm Goddess, Guandi, and Wenchang, which receive an expanded ensemble.

sentences.zh: 笛、笙、鼓同中和韶樂，雲鑼、管、板同丹陛大樂。

translations.literal: Di, sheng, and drums are the same as in Zhonghe Shao Music; cloud gongs, guan pipes, and clapper boards are the same as in Danbi Grand Music.
translations.idiomatic: Di, sheng, and drums match Zhonghe Shao Music; cloud gongs, guan pipes, and clapper boards match Danbi Grand Music.

sentences.zh: 宴樂凡九：一曰隊舞樂，一曰瓦爾喀部樂，一曰朝鮮樂，一曰蒙古樂，一曰回部樂，一曰番子樂，一曰廓爾喀部樂，一曰緬甸國樂，一曰安南國樂。

translations.literal: Banquet music totals nine: first, team dance music; second, Uriankhai music; third, Korean music; fourth, Mongol music; fifth, Muslim music; sixth, Tibetan music; seventh, Gurkha music; eighth, Burmese music; ninth, Annamese music.
translations.idiomatic: Banquet music comprises nine traditions: team dance music, Uriankhai music, Korean music, Mongol music, Muslim music, Tibetan music, Gurkha music, Burmese music, and Annamese music.

sentences.zh: 隊舞有三：一曰慶隆舞，凡殿廷朝會宮中慶賀宴饗皆用之；

translations.literal: Team dances number three: first, Celebratory Prosperity Dance, used for all palace court assemblies, palace celebrations, and banquets;
translations.idiomatic: There are three team dances: first, the Celebratory Prosperity Dance, performed at all palace court assemblies, celebrations, and banquets;

sentences.zh: 一曰世德舞，宴宗室用之；

translations.literal: second, Hereditary Virtue Dance, used at banquets for the imperial clan;
translations.idiomatic: second, the Hereditary Virtue Dance, performed at banquets for the imperial clan;

sentences.zh: 一曰德勝舞，凱旋筵宴用之。

translations.literal: third, Victorious Triumph Dance, used at victory-return banquets.
translations.idiomatic: third, the Victorious Triumph Dance, performed at triumphal banquet feasts.

sentences.zh: 三舞同制，皆舞而節以樂。

translations.literal: The three dances share the same form; all are danced with music marking the rhythm.
translations.idiomatic: All three dances share the same choreography, each performed to music that sets the rhythm.

sentences.zh: 其器用箏一，奚琴一，琵琶三，三弦三，節十六，拍十六。

translations.literal: Their instruments use one zheng, one xiqin, three pipa, three sanxian, sixteen jie, sixteen pai.
translations.idiomatic: Their instruments are one zheng, one xiqin, three pipa, three sanxian, sixteen jie rhythm clappers, and sixteen pai clappers.

sentences.zh: 箏，似瑟而小，刳桐為質，通長四尺七寸三分八釐五豪。

translations.literal: The zheng resembles the se but smaller; paulownia is hollowed for the body; total length four chi seven cun three fen eight li five hao.
translations.idiomatic: The zheng resembles the se but smaller, its body hollowed from paulownia—four chi, seven cun, three fen, eight li, and five hao long overall.

sentences.zh: 十四弦，弦皆五十四綸，各隨宮調設柱。

translations.literal: Fourteen strings; each string has fifty-four strands; movable bridges are set according to each mode.
translations.idiomatic: It has fourteen strings of fifty-four strands each, with movable bridges placed according to the mode.

sentences.zh: 底孔二。

translations.literal: Two holes in the base.
translations.idiomatic: The base has two sound holes.

sentences.zh: 前方，後上圓下平，通體魨金，四邊繪金夔龍。

translations.literal: Square in front; behind, round above and flat below; the whole coated with lacquer and gilded, the four edges painted with gilded kui dragons.
translations.idiomatic: The front face is square; the back is rounded above and flat below; the whole is lacquered and gilded, with gilt kui dragons painted along all four edges.

sentences.zh: 梁及尾邊用紫檀，弦孔以象牙為飾。

translations.literal: The bridge and tail edge use red sandalwood; string holes are ornamented with ivory.
translations.idiomatic: The bridge and tail edge are red sandalwood; ivory ornaments the string holes.

sentences.zh: 奚琴，刳桐為質，二弦。

translations.literal: The xiqin: paulownia is hollowed for the body; two strings.
translations.idiomatic: The xiqin has a paulownia body and two strings.

sentences.zh: 龍首，方柄。

translations.literal: Dragon head; square neck.
translations.idiomatic: It has a dragon head and a square neck.

sentences.zh: 槽長與柄等。

translations.literal: The sound box is as long as the neck.
translations.idiomatic: The sound box matches the neck in length.

sentences.zh: 背圓中凹，覆以板。

translations.literal: The back is round with a concave center, covered with a plate.
translations.idiomatic: The back is rounded and concave at the center, covered with a plate.

sentences.zh: 槽端設圓柱，施皮扣以結弦。

translations.literal: A round pillar is set at the sound-box end; leather loops are fitted to tie the strings.
translations.idiomatic: A round pillar at the sound-box end takes leather loops for string attachment.

sentences.zh: 龍頭下脣為山口，鑿空納弦。

translations.literal: Below the dragon head the lip forms the string notch; hollowed to receive the strings.
translations.idiomatic: The lip below the dragon head serves as the nut, hollowed to pass the strings through.

sentences.zh: 綰以兩軸，左右各一，以木系馬尾八十一莖軋之。

translations.literal: Bound with two pegs, one left and one right; a wooden bow strung with eighty-one strands of horsehair is drawn across it.
translations.idiomatic: Two tuning pegs, one on each side, secure the strings; it is played with a wooden bow strung with eighty-one horsehair strands.

sentences.zh: 琵琶，刳桐為質，四弦，曲首長頸，平面圓背，腹廣而橢。

translations.literal: The pipa: paulownia is hollowed for the body; four strings; curved head and long neck; flat face and round back; broad, oval belly.
translations.idiomatic: The pipa has a paulownia body, four strings, a curved head and long neck, a flat soundboard and rounded back, and a broad, oval belly.

sentences.zh: 槽面施覆手，曲首中間為山口。

translations.literal: A hand guard is fitted on the sound-box face; the middle of the curved head forms the nut.
translations.idiomatic: The sound-box face bears a hand guard; the center of the curved head serves as the nut.

sentences.zh: 設檀軸四以綰弦，左右各二，山口上以黃楊木為四象，下以竹為十三品，按分取聲。

translations.literal: Four sandalwood pegs are set to bind the strings, two left and two right; above the nut four elephant-shaped pieces of boxwood are made, below thirteen bamboo frets are set; pitch is taken by pressing to the divisions.
translations.idiomatic: Four sandalwood tuning pegs secure the strings, two on each side; above the nut are four boxwood elephant-shaped pegs, and below are thirteen bamboo frets for obtaining pitch by division.

sentences.zh: 中腰兩旁為新月形，腹內以細鋼條為膽，弦自山口至覆手，長二尺一寸六分，第一弦以硃飾之。

translations.literal: Both sides of the middle waist are crescent-shaped; within the belly fine steel strips serve as ribs; strings from the nut to the hand guard measure two chi one cun six fen in length; the first string is ornamented with vermilion.
translations.idiomatic: The waist is crescent-shaped on both sides; fine steel strips reinforce the belly; the strings measure two chi, one cun, and six fen from nut to hand guard; the first string is trimmed in vermilion.

sentences.zh: 三弦，斫檀為質，修柄，方槽，圓角，冒以虺皮。

translations.literal: The sanxian: sandalwood is carved for the body; long neck; square sound box; rounded corners; covered with python skin.
translations.idiomatic: The sanxian is carved from sandalwood, with a long neck, square sound box, rounded corners, and python-skin covering.

sentences.zh: 柄貫槽中，柄末槽端覆以木。

translations.literal: The neck passes through the sound box; the neck end and sound-box end are capped with wood.
translations.idiomatic: The neck runs through the sound box; both the neck end and the sound-box end are capped with wood.

sentences.zh: 穿孔貫弦，匙頭下半鑿空納弦，以三軸綰之，左二右一。

translations.literal: Holes are pierced to pass the strings; the lower half of the spoon-shaped head is hollowed to receive the strings; bound with three pegs, two left and one right.
translations.idiomatic: Pierced holes carry the strings; the lower half of the spoon-shaped head is hollowed to anchor them, secured by three tuning pegs—two on the left and one on the right.

sentences.zh: 節，編竹如箕，魨硃，背為虎形。

translations.literal: Jie: bamboo is woven like a winnowing basket, lacquered vermilion; the back is in tiger shape.
translations.idiomatic: The jie rhythm clapper is woven bamboo shaped like a winnowing tray, lacquered vermilion, with a tiger-shaped back.

sentences.zh: 用圓竹二，劃之以為節。

translations.literal: Two round bamboo rods are used; scored to serve as rhythm markers.
translations.idiomatic: It is played with two round bamboo rods scored to mark the beat.

sentences.zh: 拍，紫檀皮四片，束其三，以一拍之。

translations.literal: Pai: four pieces of red sandalwood and hide; three are bound together; one strikes against them.
translations.idiomatic: The pai clapper comprises four red-sandalwood-and-hide slats; three are bound together and struck with the fourth.

sentences.zh: 太祖平瓦爾喀部，獲其樂，列於宴樂，是為瓦爾喀部樂舞。

translations.literal: The Taizu pacified the Uriankhai tribe, obtained their music, listed it among banquet music—this is Uriankhai music and dance.
translations.idiomatic: When the Taizu pacified the Uriankhai tribe and captured their music, it was enrolled among the banquet music as the Uriankhai music and dance.

sentences.zh: 用觱篥四，奚琴四。

translations.literal: Uses four bili and four xiqin.
translations.idiomatic: It employs four bili pipes and four xiqin.

sentences.zh: 奚琴同隊舞樂。

translations.literal: The xiqin is the same as in team dance music.
translations.idiomatic: The xiqin matches that used in team dance music.

sentences.zh: 觱篥，蘆管，三孔，金口，下哆，中有小孔。

translations.literal: Bili: reed pipe; three holes; gold mouthpiece; flared at the lower end; a small hole in the middle.
translations.idiomatic: The bili is a reed pipe with three finger holes, a gold mouthpiece, a flared bell, and a small vent hole midway.

sentences.zh: 管端開簧，簧口距管末四寸五分三釐。

translations.literal: A reed is opened at the pipe end; the reed mouth is four cun five fen three li from the pipe end.
translations.idiomatic: A reed is set at the pipe end, its mouth four cun, five fen, and three li from the pipe's tip.

sentences.zh: 太宗時，獲朝鮮國樂，列於宴樂，是為朝鮮國俳。

translations.literal: In the Taizong reign, Korean music was obtained, listed among banquet music—this is the Korean troupe performance.
translations.idiomatic: During the Taizong's reign, Korean music was acquired and enrolled among the banquet music as the Korean troupe performance.

sentences.zh: 用笛一，管一，俳鼓一。

translations.literal: Uses one di flute, one guan pipe, one performance drum.
translations.idiomatic: It uses one di flute, one guan pipe, and one performance drum.

sentences.zh: 笛同中和韶樂，管同丹陛大樂。

translations.literal: The di is the same as in Zhonghe Shao Music; the guan is the same as in Danbi Grand Music.
translations.idiomatic: The di matches that of Zhonghe Shao Music; the guan matches that of Danbi Grand Music.

sentences.zh: 俳鼓如龍鼓而小，懸於項擊之。

translations.literal: The performance drum resembles the dragon drum but smaller; suspended at the neck and struck.
translations.idiomatic: The performance drum resembles a dragon drum but smaller; worn suspended at the neck and struck.

sentences.zh: 太宗平察哈爾，獲其樂，列於宴樂，是為蒙古樂曲。

translations.literal: The Taizong pacified Chahar, obtained their music, listed it among banquet music—this is Mongol musical pieces.
translations.idiomatic: When the Taizong pacified Chahar and captured their music, it was enrolled among the banquet music as Mongol musical pieces.

sentences.zh: 有笳吹，有番部合奏，皆為掇爾多密之樂，掌於什幫處。

translations.literal: There is reed-pipe blowing, there is frontier ensemble; all are music of the duo er duo mi, administered by the Shibang Office.
translations.idiomatic: It includes reed-pipe performance and frontier ensemble—both forms of duo er duo mi music administered by the Shibang Office.

sentences.zh: 笳吹用胡笳一，箏一，胡琴一，口琴一。

translations.literal: Reed-pipe blowing uses one hu-jia, one zheng, one huqin, one kouqin.
translations.idiomatic: The reed-pipe ensemble employs one hu-jia, one zheng, one huqin, and one kouqin.

sentences.zh: 箏與隊舞所用同，惟設六弦。

translations.literal: The zheng is the same as used in team dance, only set with six strings.
translations.idiomatic: The zheng matches that used in team dance music, but has only six strings.

sentences.zh: 胡笳，木管，三孔，兩端施角，末翹而哆。

translations.literal: Hu-jia: wooden pipe; three holes; horn fitted at both ends; tip upturned and flared.
translations.idiomatic: The hu-jia is a wooden pipe with three holes, horn caps at both ends, and an upturned, flared bell.

sentences.zh: 自吹口至末，二尺三寸九分六釐。

translations.literal: From blow-hole to end, two chi three cun nine fen six li.
translations.idiomatic: From blow-hole to tip it measures two chi, three cun, nine fen, and six li.

sentences.zh: 胡琴，刳木為質，二弦，龍首，方柄。

translations.literal: Huqin: wood is hollowed for the body; two strings; dragon head; square neck.
translations.idiomatic: The huqin has a hollowed wooden body, two strings, a dragon head, and a square neck.

sentences.zh: 槽橢而下銳，冒以革。

translations.literal: The sound box is oval and tapers to a point below; covered with hide.
translations.idiomatic: The sound box is oval, tapering to a sharp lower edge, and covered with hide.

sentences.zh: 槽外設木如簪頭以扣弦，龍首下為山口，鑿空納弦，綰以二軸，左右各一。

translations.literal: Outside the sound box wood like a hairpin head is set to clip the strings; below the dragon head is the nut; hollowed to receive strings; bound with two pegs, one left and one right.
translations.idiomatic: Outside the sound box a hairpin-shaped wooden piece clips the strings; the nut below the dragon head is hollowed to pass the strings, secured by two pegs, one on each side.

sentences.zh: 以木系馬尾八十一莖軋之。

translations.literal: A wooden bow strung with eighty-one strands of horsehair is drawn across it.
translations.idiomatic: It is played with a wooden bow strung with eighty-one horsehair strands.

sentences.zh: 口琴，以鐵為之，一柄兩股，中設簧，末出股外。

translations.literal: Kouqin: made of iron; one handle and two prongs; a reed set in the middle; tips extending beyond the prongs.
translations.idiomatic: The kouqin is iron, with one handle and two prongs, a reed set between them, its tips extending beyond the prongs.

sentences.zh: 橫銜於口，鼓簧轉舌，噓吸以成音。

translations.literal: Held horizontally in the mouth; the reed is excited and the tongue turned; blowing and sucking produce the tones.
translations.idiomatic: Held crosswise in the mouth, its reed and tongue are set vibrating by breath drawn in and blown out.

sentences.zh: 番部合奏，用雲鑼一，簫一，笛一，管一，笙一，箏一，胡琴一，琵琶一，三弦一，二弦一，月琴一，提琴一，軋箏一，火不思一，拍板一。

translations.literal: Frontier ensemble uses one cloud gong, one xiao, one di, one guan, one sheng, one zheng, one huqin, one pipa, one sanxian, one erxian, one yueqin, one tiqin, one yazheng, one huobusi, one clapper board.
translations.idiomatic: The frontier ensemble employs one cloud gong, xiao, di, guan, sheng, zheng, huqin, pipa, sanxian, erxian, yueqin, tiqin, yazheng, huobusi, and clapper boards.

sentences.zh: 簫、笛、笙同中和韶樂，雲鑼、管同丹陛大樂，箏、琵琶、三弦同隊舞樂。

translations.literal: Xiao, di, and sheng are the same as in Zhonghe Shao Music; cloud gongs and guan are the same as in Danbi Grand Music; zheng, pipa, and sanxian are the same as in team dance music.
translations.idiomatic: The xiao, di, and sheng match Zhonghe Shao Music; the cloud gongs and guan match Danbi Grand Music; the zheng, pipa, and sanxian match team dance music.

sentences.zh: 胡琴，二弦，竹柄椰槽，面以桐。

translations.literal: Huqin: two strings; bamboo neck and coconut sound box; face of paulownia.
translations.idiomatic: This huqin has two strings, a bamboo neck and coconut shell sound box, and a paulownia face.

sentences.zh: 槽徑三寸八分四釐，為圓形，與笳吹之胡琴橢而下銳者不同。

translations.literal: Sound-box diameter three cun eight fen four li, circular in form, unlike the reed-pipe huqin which is oval and tapers below.
translations.idiomatic: The sound box is circular, three cun, eight fen, and four li in diameter—unlike the reed-pipe huqin, which is oval and tapers to a point.

sentences.zh: 山口鑿空納弦，以兩軸綰之，俱在右。

translations.literal: The nut is hollowed to receive strings; bound with two pegs, both on the right.
translations.idiomatic: The nut is hollowed for the strings, secured by two pegs, both on the right side.

sentences.zh: 弦自山口至柱，長二尺三分五釐二豪，以竹弓系馬尾八十一莖軋之。

translations.literal: Strings from nut to bridge, length two chi three fen five li two hao; a bamboo bow strung with eighty-one horsehair strands is drawn across it.
translations.idiomatic: The strings measure two chi, three fen, five li, and two hao from nut to bridge; a bamboo bow with eighty-one horsehair strands is drawn across them.

sentences.zh: 二弦，斫樟為質，槽面以桐，形長方，底有孔，槽面施覆手如琵琶。

translations.literal: Erxian: camphor is carved for the body; sound-box face of paulownia; rectangular in form; holes in the base; hand guard fitted on sound-box face like the pipa.
translations.idiomatic: The erxian is carved from camphor with a paulownia soundboard, a rectangular body, sound holes in the base, and a pipa-style hand guard.

sentences.zh: 曲首後鑿空納弦，綰以兩軸，左右各一。

translations.literal: Behind the curved head is hollowed to receive strings; bound with two pegs, one left and one right.
translations.idiomatic: Behind the curved head the strings pass through a hollow, secured by two pegs, one on each side.

sentences.zh: 弦長二尺三寸四釐，設十七品，按分取聲。

translations.literal: String length two chi three cun four li; seventeen frets are set; pitch is taken by pressing to the divisions.
translations.idiomatic: The strings are two chi, three cun, and four li long, with seventeen frets for obtaining pitch by division.

sentences.zh: 月琴，斫檀為質，四弦，槽面以桐，八角曲項，柄貫槽中，槽面施覆手。

translations.literal: Yueqin: sandalwood carved for the body; four strings; sound-box face of paulownia; eight-sided curved neck; neck passes through sound box; hand guard fitted on sound-box face.
translations.idiomatic: The yueqin is carved from sandalwood, with four strings, a paulownia soundboard, an eight-sided curved neck running through the sound box, and a hand guard on the face.

sentences.zh: 曲項鑿空納弦，綰以四軸，左右各二。

translations.literal: The curved neck is hollowed to receive strings; bound with four pegs, two left and two right.
translations.idiomatic: The curved neck is hollowed for the strings, secured by four pegs, two on each side.

sentences.zh: 弦長二尺三寸四釐，設十七品，與二弦同。

translations.literal: String length two chi three cun four li; seventeen frets are set; the same as the erxian.
translations.idiomatic: The strings are two chi, three cun, and four li long, with seventeen frets—the same as the erxian.

sentences.zh: 提琴，四弦，圓木為槽，冒以蟒皮而空其下，竹柄貫槽中，末出槽外。

translations.literal: Tiqin: four strings; round wood for the sound box; covered with python skin but hollowed below; bamboo neck passes through the sound box, end extending beyond it.
translations.idiomatic: The tiqin has four strings, a round wooden sound box covered with python skin and open underneath, and a bamboo neck running through the box with its tip projecting beyond.

sentences.zh: 覆木扣弦，柄端鑿空納弦，綰以四軸，俱在右。

translations.literal: A wooden cover clips the strings; the neck end is hollowed to receive strings; bound with four pegs, all on the right.
translations.idiomatic: A wooden string clip covers the face; the neck end is hollowed for the strings, secured by four pegs all on the right.

sentences.zh: 以竹弓系馬尾，夾於四弦間軋之。

translations.literal: A bamboo bow strung with horsehair is drawn between the four strings.
translations.idiomatic: A bamboo bow strung with horsehair is drawn between the four strings.

sentences.zh: 軋箏，似箏而小，刳桐為質，十弦。

translations.literal: Yazheng: resembles the zheng but smaller; paulownia hollowed for the body; ten strings.
translations.idiomatic: The yazheng resembles the zheng but smaller, its paulownia body bearing ten strings.

sentences.zh: 前後有梁，梁內弦長一尺六寸一分八釐，各設柱，以木杆軋之。

translations.literal: Bridges front and back; within the bridges string length one chi six cun one fen eight li; each has a bridge post; a wooden rod is drawn across it.
translations.idiomatic: Bridges run front and back; the vibrating length within them is one chi, six cun, one fen, and eight li; each string has a bridge post; a wooden rod is drawn across the strings.

sentences.zh: 火不思，似琵琶而瘦，四弦，桐柄，刳其下半為槽，冒以蟒皮。

translations.literal: Huobusi: resembles the pipa but slender; four strings; paulownia neck; lower half hollowed for the sound box; covered with python skin.
translations.idiomatic: The huobusi resembles a slender pipa, with four strings, a paulownia neck, a sound box hollowed from its lower half and covered with python skin.

sentences.zh: 曲首鑿空納弦，四軸綰之，俱在右。

translations.literal: The curved head is hollowed to receive strings; four pegs bind them, all on the right.
translations.idiomatic: The curved head is hollowed for the strings, secured by four pegs all on the right.

sentences.zh: 弦自山口至柱長一尺七寸七分四釐。

translations.literal: Strings from nut to bridge, length one chi seven cun seven fen four li.
translations.idiomatic: The strings measure one chi, seven cun, seven fen, and four li from nut to bridge.

sentences.zh: 拍板，紫檀三片，束其二，以一拍之。

translations.literal: Clapper boards: three pieces of red sandalwood; two are bound together; one strikes against them.
translations.idiomatic: The clapper boards are three red sandalwood slats; two are bound together and struck with the third.

sentences.zh: 高宗平定回部，獲其樂，列於宴樂之末，是為回部樂技，用達卜一，那噶喇一，哈爾札克一，喀爾奈一，塞他爾一，喇巴卜一，巴拉滿一，蘇爾奈一。

translations.literal: The Gaozong pacified the Muslim regions, obtained their music, listed at the end of banquet music—this is Muslim music and performance; uses one dabu, one nagara, one karak, one karne, one setar, one rabab, one balaman, one suernai.
translations.idiomatic: When the Gaozong pacified the Muslim regions and captured their music, it was placed last among the banquet music as Muslim performance music, employing one dabu, nagara, karak, karne, setar, rabab, balaman, and suernai.

sentences.zh: 達卜，木匡冒革，形如手鼓而無柄。

translations.literal: Dabu: wooden frame covered with hide; shaped like a hand drum but without a handle.
translations.idiomatic: The dabu is a handleless hand drum with a wooden frame covered in hide.

sentences.zh: 有大小二制，一面徑一尺三寸六分五釐二豪，一面徑一尺二寸二分四釐，皆魨黃，面繪采獅，以手指擊之。

translations.literal: Large and small types; one face diameter one chi three cun six fen five li two hao, one face diameter one chi two cun two fen four li; all lacquered yellow; lion painted in colors on the face; struck with the fingers.
translations.idiomatic: It comes in large and small sizes—face diameters of one chi, three cun, six fen, five li, and two hao, and one chi, two cun, two fen, and four li—all lacquered yellow with polychrome lions painted on the head, played by finger strikes.

sentences.zh: 那噶喇，鐵匡冒革，上大下小，形如行鼓。

translations.literal: Nagara: iron frame covered with hide; large above and small below; shaped like a marching drum.
translations.idiomatic: The nagara has an iron frame covered with hide, wider above and narrower below, in the form of a marching drum.

sentences.zh: 旁有小鐶，系黃絨紃。

translations.literal: Small rings at the sides; yellow velvet cords attached.
translations.idiomatic: Small rings at the sides carry yellow velvet cords.

sentences.zh: 兩鼓相聯，左右各以杖擊之。

translations.literal: Two drums linked together; each is struck with sticks left and right.
translations.idiomatic: Two drums are joined and struck with sticks, one in each hand.

sentences.zh: 哈爾札克，形如胡琴，椰槽，冒以馬革。

translations.literal: Karak: shaped like the huqin; coconut sound box; covered with horse hide.
translations.idiomatic: The karak resembles the huqin, with a coconut shell sound box covered in horsehide.

sentences.zh: 上木柄，下鐵柄。

translations.literal: Wooden neck above; iron handle below.
translations.idiomatic: It has a wooden neck above and an iron handle below.

sentences.zh: 槽底中開一孔，側開三小孔。

translations.literal: One hole opened at the center of the sound-box base; three small holes opened at the sides.
translations.idiomatic: The sound-box base has one central hole and three small side holes.

sentences.zh: 以馬尾二縷為弦，上自山口穿於後，以兩軸綰之，左右各一，下系鐵柄。

translations.literal: Two strands of horsehair serve as strings; above they pass from the nut through to the back, bound with two pegs, one left and one right; below attached to the iron handle.
translations.idiomatic: Two horsehair strings pass from the nut through the back, secured by two pegs, one on each side, and attach below to the iron handle.

sentences.zh: 馬尾弦下設鋼絲弦十，上系木柄，下擊鐵柄，左右各五軸。

translations.literal: Below the horsehair strings ten steel strings are set; above attached to the wooden neck, below striking the iron handle; five pegs left and five right.
translations.idiomatic: Beneath the horsehair strings lie ten steel strings—anchored to the wooden neck above and resting against the iron handle below—with five pegs on each side.

sentences.zh: 另以木杆為弓，系馬尾八十餘莖，軋馬尾弦，應鋼弦取聲。

translations.literal: Separately a wooden rod serves as bow, strung with eighty-odd horsehair strands; the horsehair strings are bowed, responding to the steel strings to obtain pitch.
translations.idiomatic: A separate wooden bow strung with eighty-odd horsehair strands bows the horsehair strings, which in turn resonate the steel strings to produce tone.

sentences.zh: 喀爾奈，狀如世俗洋琴，鋼絲弦十八，刳木中虛，左直右曲。

translations.literal: Karne: in form like the common Western zither; eighteen steel strings; wood hollowed within; straight on the left, curved on the right.
translations.idiomatic: The karne resembles a Western zither, with eighteen steel strings in a hollowed wooden body, straight on the left and curved on the right.

sentences.zh: 左設梁如琴之岳山，以系鋼弦之本。

translations.literal: A bridge is set on the left like the yueshan of the qin, to anchor the roots of the steel strings.
translations.idiomatic: On the left a bridge like the qin's yueshan anchors the steel strings at their head.

sentences.zh: 鋼弦之末施木軸，似琴之軫，入於右端，高下相間作兩層，轉其軸以定弦之緩急。

translations.literal: At the ends of the steel strings wooden pegs are fitted, like the tuning pegs of the qin, entering the right end, high and low alternately in two tiers; turning the pegs fixes string tightness.
translations.idiomatic: Wooden pegs like qin tuning pegs at the string ends enter the right side in two staggered tiers; turning them sets each string's tension.

sentences.zh: 以手冒撥指，或木撥彈之，通體雙弦，惟第一獨弦。

translations.literal: Played with finger picks on the hand, or plucked with a wooden pick; throughout paired strings, only the first a single string.
translations.idiomatic: It is plucked with finger picks or a wooden plectrum; all courses are doubled except the first, which is single.

sentences.zh: 塞他爾。

translations.literal: Setar.
translations.idiomatic: The setar.

sentences.zh: 形如匕，絲弦二，綱弦七，木柄通槽，下冒以革。

translations.literal: Shaped like a dagger; two silk strings, seven wire strings; wooden neck through the sound box; lower part covered with hide.
translations.idiomatic: Shaped like a dagger, it has two silk and seven wire strings, a wooden neck running through the sound box, and a hide-covered lower body.

sentences.zh: 面平背圓，柄有線箍二十三道，如琵琶之品。

translations.literal: Flat face and round back; the neck has twenty-three cord frets, like the frets of the pipa.
translations.idiomatic: The face is flat and the back rounded; twenty-three cord frets ring the neck like pipa frets.

sentences.zh: 以九軸綰弦，柄端二軸綰絲弦。

translations.literal: Nine pegs bind the strings; two pegs at the neck end bind the silk strings.
translations.idiomatic: Nine tuning pegs secure the strings; two at the neck end hold the silk strings.

sentences.zh: 二面三軸，左側四軸，綰鋼質雙弦一，獨弦六。

translations.literal: Two on the face and three pegs; four pegs on the left side; binding one steel double-string course and six single strings.
translations.idiomatic: Two pegs on the face and three more, with four on the left side, hold one paired steel course and six single strings.

sentences.zh: 以手冒撥指，或木撥彈絲弦，應鋼弦取聲。

translations.literal: With finger picks on the hand, or a wooden pick plucking the silk strings, responding to the steel strings to obtain pitch.
translations.idiomatic: Finger picks or a wooden plectrum pluck the silk strings, which resonate the steel strings to produce tone.

sentences.zh: 喇巴卜，絲弦五，鋼弦二，木柄通槽，槽形如半瓶，下冒以革。

translations.literal: Rabab: five silk strings, two steel strings; wooden neck through sound box; sound box shaped like half a bottle; lower part covered with hide.
translations.idiomatic: The rabab has five silk and two steel strings, a wooden neck through a sound box shaped like half a bottle, and a hide-covered lower body.

sentences.zh: 曲首鑿空納絲弦，以五軸綰之，左二右三，曲首右側以兩軸綰綱弦。

translations.literal: The curved head is hollowed to receive silk strings; bound with five pegs, two left and three right; on the right side of the curved head two pegs bind the wire strings.
translations.idiomatic: The curved head is hollowed for the silk strings, secured by five pegs—two left, three right—with two additional pegs on the right for the wire strings.

sentences.zh: 用手冒撥指，或木撥彈絲弦，應綱弦取聲。

translations.literal: With finger picks on the hand, or a wooden pick plucking silk strings, responding to wire strings to obtain pitch.
translations.idiomatic: Finger picks or a wooden plectrum pluck the silk strings, which resonate the wire strings to produce tone.

sentences.zh: 巴拉滿，木管，上斂下哆，飾以銅，形如頭管而有底，開小孔以出音。

translations.literal: Balaman: wooden pipe; narrow above and flared below; ornamented with copper; shaped like the touguan but with a base; small holes opened for sound.
translations.idiomatic: The balaman is a wooden pipe, narrow above and flared below, copper-trimmed, shaped like a touguan but closed at the base, with small tone holes.

sentences.zh: 管通長九寸四分，七孔前出，一孔後出，管上設蘆哨吹之。

translations.literal: Total pipe length nine cun four fen; seven holes facing forward, one facing back; a reed mouthpiece is set on the pipe for blowing.
translations.idiomatic: The pipe is nine cun and four fen long, with seven front holes and one back hole; a reed mouthpiece atop the pipe supplies the air column.

sentences.zh: 蘇爾奈，一名瑣，木管，兩端飾銅，上斂下哆，形如金口角而小。

translations.literal: Suernai, also called suo: wooden pipe; both ends ornamented with copper; narrow above and flared below; shaped like the gold-mouthed horn but smaller.
translations.idiomatic: The suernai, also called the suo, is a wooden pipe copper-trimmed at both ends, narrow above and flared below, resembling a small gold-mouthed horn.

sentences.zh: 七孔前出，一孔後出，一孔左出，銅管上設蘆哨吹之。

translations.literal: Seven holes facing forward, one facing back, one facing left; a reed mouthpiece is set on the copper pipe for blowing.
translations.idiomatic: It has seven front holes, one back hole, and one left-side hole; a reed mouthpiece on the copper section supplies the air column.

sentences.zh: 高宗平定金川，獲其樂，及後藏班禪額爾德尼來朝，獻其樂，均列於宴樂之末，是為番子樂。

translations.literal: The Gaozong pacified Jinchuan and obtained their music; and when the Panchen Erdeni of rear Tibet came to court and presented their music, both were listed at the end of banquet music—this is Tibetan music.
translations.idiomatic: When the Gaozong pacified Jinchuan and captured its music, and later when the Panchen Erdeni of Rear Tibet came to court bearing Tibetan music, both were placed last among the banquet music as Tibetan music.

sentences.zh: 金川之樂：曰阿爾薩蘭，曰大郭庄，曰四角魯。

translations.literal: Jinchuan music: called Arsalan, called Daguzhuang, called Sijiaolu.
translations.idiomatic: Jinchuan music includes Arsalan, Daguzhuang, and Sijiaolu.

sentences.zh: 用得梨一，柏且爾一、得勒窩一。

translations.literal: Uses one deli, one boqie'er, one delewo.
translations.idiomatic: It employs one deli, one boqie'er, and one delewo.

sentences.zh: 得梨，似蘇爾奈而小。

translations.literal: Deli: resembles the suernai but smaller.
translations.idiomatic: The deli resembles the suernai but is smaller.

sentences.zh: 柏且爾，范銅二片，圓徑六寸，中隆起，穿孔貫紃，左右合擊。

translations.literal: Boqie'er: two copper pieces cast; round diameter six cun; center raised; holes pierced and cords passed through; struck together left and right.
translations.idiomatic: The boqie'er consists of two cast copper discs six cun in diameter, domed at the center, pierced and linked by cord, clashed together in the hands.

sentences.zh: 得勒窩，形似達卜。

translations.literal: Delewo: in shape like the dabu.
translations.idiomatic: The delewo resembles the dabu in form.

sentences.zh: 班禪之樂：曰札什倫布，用得梨二，巴汪一，蒼清一，龍思馬爾得勒窩四。

translations.literal: Panchen music: called Tashilhunpo; uses two deli, one bawang, one cangqing, four longsimar delewo.
translations.idiomatic: Panchen music includes Tashilhunpo, employing two deli, one bawang, one cangqing, and four longsimar delewo.

sentences.zh: 得梨同金川樂，形制略大。

translations.literal: The deli is the same as in Jinchuan music, slightly larger in form.
translations.idiomatic: The deli matches that of Jinchuan music but is slightly larger.

sentences.zh: 巴汪，似喇巴卜，七弦。

translations.literal: Bawang: resembles the rabab; seven strings.
translations.idiomatic: The bawang resembles the rabab and has seven strings.

sentences.zh: 蒼清，制同雲鑼。

translations.literal: Cangqing: same construction as cloud gongs.
translations.idiomatic: The cangqing is constructed like the cloud gongs.

sentences.zh: 龍思馬爾得勒窩，似那噶喇而制以銅，面徑一尺三寸，底銳，匡高一尺。

translations.literal: Longsimar delewo: resembles the nagara but made of copper; face diameter one chi three cun; base sharp; frame height one chi.
translations.idiomatic: The longsimar delewo resembles the nagara but is copper, with a one-chi-three-cun face, a pointed base, and a one-chi frame height.

sentences.zh: 高宗平定廓爾喀，獲其樂，列於宴樂之末，是為廓爾喀樂舞。

translations.literal: The Gaozong pacified Gurkha, obtained their music, listed at the end of banquet music—this is Gurkha music and dance.
translations.idiomatic: When the Gaozong pacified Gurkha and captured their music, it was placed last among the banquet music as Gurkha music and dance.

sentences.zh: 用達布拉一，薩朗濟三，丹布拉一，達拉一，公古哩二。

translations.literal: Uses one dabula, three salangji, one danbula, one dala, two gonguli.
translations.idiomatic: It employs one dabula, three salangji, one danbula, one dala, and two gonguli.

sentences.zh: 達布拉，似那噶喇，一面冒革。

translations.literal: Dabula: resembles the nagara; one face covered with hide.
translations.idiomatic: The dabula resembles the nagara, with one head covered in hide.

sentences.zh: 有二制：其一面豐底銳，其一底微豐而漸削。

translations.literal: Two types: one with a full face and sharp base; one with a slightly full base tapering gradually.
translations.idiomatic: It comes in two styles—one with a broad face and sharp base, another with a slightly rounded base that tapers away.

sentences.zh: 四圍俱系韋絛，聯以采縷，懸之腰間，以左右手合擊之。

translations.literal: Hide thongs are attached all around; linked with colored cords; suspended at the waist; struck together with left and right hands.
translations.idiomatic: Hide thongs circle the frame, joined with colored cord, so it can be worn at the waist and struck with both hands.

sentences.zh: 薩朗濟，刻木為質，韋弦四，鐵弦九。

translations.literal: Salangji: wood carved for the body; four gut strings, nine iron strings.
translations.idiomatic: The salangji is carved from wood, with four gut strings and nine iron strings.

sentences.zh: 項長三寸，刳其中，面以魚牙刻佛為飾。

translations.literal: Neck length three cun; hollowed within; the face ornamented with Buddha carved in fish ivory.
translations.idiomatic: The neck is three cun long, hollowed inside, its face ornamented with a Buddha carved in fish ivory.

sentences.zh: 柄長五寸二分，槽面闊三寸，自上刳之，冒以革。

translations.literal: Neck length five cun two fen; sound-box face width three cun; hollowed from above; covered with hide.
translations.idiomatic: The neck is five cun and two fen long; the sound-box face is three cun wide, hollowed from above and covered with hide.

sentences.zh: 中腰削如缺月，束以黃韋。

translations.literal: The middle waist is pared like a crescent moon, bound with yellow hide.
translations.idiomatic: The waist tapers to a crescent profile, wrapped in yellow leather.

sentences.zh: 底橢，鑿空於項以納韋弦，左右各二。

translations.literal: The base is oval; hollowed at the neck to receive gut strings, two left and two right.
translations.idiomatic: The base is oval; the neck is hollowed for four gut strings—two on each side.

sentences.zh: 軸柄面穿孔九，自右至左，鱗次斜列，各納鐵弦。

translations.literal: On the peg-handle face nine holes are pierced; from right to left they are staggered diagonally like scales; each receives an iron string.
translations.idiomatic: Nine holes pierce the peg face, set diagonally in overlapping rows from right to left, each carrying an iron string.

sentences.zh: 軸九，俱在右，上五下四。

translations.literal: Nine pegs, all on the right; five above, four below.
translations.idiomatic: All nine tuning pegs are on the right—five above and four below.

sentences.zh: 槽面設柱，中為九孔納鐵弦，上承韋弦。

translations.literal: A bridge is set on the sound-box face; at the center are nine holes receiving iron strings; above they support the gut strings.
translations.idiomatic: A bridge on the soundboard holds nine iron-string holes at center, over which the gut strings pass.

sentences.zh: 以柔木系馬尾軋韋弦，應鐵弦取聲。

translations.literal: A pliant wooden bow strung with horsehair is drawn across the gut strings, responding to the iron strings to obtain pitch.
translations.idiomatic: A flexible wooden bow strung with horsehair bows the gut strings, which resonate the iron strings to produce tone.

sentences.zh: 丹布拉，刻桐為質，以大匏為槽，直柄，面平背圓，鐵弦四，綰以四軸，上二，左右各一。

translations.literal: Danbula: paulownia carved for the body; a large gourd for the sound box; straight neck; flat face, round back; four iron strings; bound with four pegs; two above, one left and one right.
translations.idiomatic: The danbula is carved from paulownia with a large gourd sound box, a straight neck, flat face and round back, four iron strings on four pegs—two above and one on each side.

sentences.zh: 柄上以鐵片二為山口，一穿孔納弦，一承弦。

translations.literal: On the neck two iron pieces serve as the nut; one pierced to receive the strings, one to support the strings.
translations.idiomatic: Two iron plates on the neck form the nut—one pierced to anchor the strings, the other to bear them.

sentences.zh: 達拉，范銅二片，圓徑二寸一分。

translations.literal: Dala: two cast copper pieces; round diameter two cun one fen.
translations.idiomatic: The dala consists of two cast copper discs two cun and one fen in diameter.

sentences.zh: 中隆起，穿孔，系以采縷，左右合擊。

translations.literal: The center is raised; holes pierced; attached with colored cords; struck together left and right.
translations.idiomatic: Domed at the center and pierced, they are linked with colored cord and clashed together in the hands.

sentences.zh: 公古哩，范銅為鈴，以采縷聯之，五十枚為一串，凡四串。

translations.literal: Gonguli: cast copper for bells; linked with colored cords; fifty pieces make one string; four strings in all.
translations.idiomatic: The gonguli are copper bells joined by colored cord, fifty to a strand, four strands in all.

sentences.zh: 歌時二人各繫於股，雙足騰躍以出聲。

translations.literal: When singing, two persons each attach them to the thigh; both feet leap and spring to produce sound.
translations.idiomatic: When they sing, two dancers strap them to their thighs and leap on both feet to sound them.

sentences.zh: 乾隆五十三年，緬甸國內附，獻其樂，列於宴樂之末，是為緬甸國樂。

translations.literal: Qianlong year 53, Burma submitted and joined the empire, presented its music, listed at the end of banquet music—this is Burma music.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-third year of Qianlong, when Burma submitted to the empire and presented its music, it was placed last among the banquet music as Burmese music.

sentences.zh: 有粗細二制：粗緬甸樂，用接內搭兜呼一，稽灣斜枯一，聶兜姜一，聶聶兜姜一，結莽聶兜布一。

translations.literal: There are coarse and fine types: coarse Burmese music uses one jienaidadouhu, one jiwanxieku, one niedoujiang, one nieniedoujiang, one jiemangniedoubu.
translations.idiomatic: It has coarse and fine styles. Coarse Burmese music employs one jienaidadouhu, one jiwanxieku, one niedoujiang, one nieniedoujiang, and one jiemangniedoubu.

sentences.zh: 接內搭兜呼，木匡冒革，匡上有紐，系以帛，橫懸於項，以手擊之。

translations.literal: Jienaidadouhu: wooden frame covered with hide; on the frame are loops; attached with silk; hung horizontally at the neck; struck with the hands.
translations.idiomatic: The jienaidadouhu is a hide-covered wooden frame with loops for silk cords, worn horizontally at the neck and struck by hand.

sentences.zh: 稽灣斜枯，制似雲鑼，其數八，上下各四，同懸於架。

translations.literal: Jiwanxieku: construction like cloud gongs; eight in number; four above and four below; suspended together on a frame.
translations.idiomatic: The jiwanxieku resembles the cloud gongs—eight in all, four above and four below, hung together on one frame.

sentences.zh: 架後搘以二木，斜倚而擊之。

translations.literal: Behind the frame two pieces of wood serve as props; struck while leaning at an angle.
translations.idiomatic: Two wooden props behind the frame support it at an angle for striking.

sentences.zh: 聶兜姜，木管銅口，近下漸哆，前七孔，後一孔。

translations.literal: Niedoujiang: wooden tube, copper mouth; toward the lower end gradually flaring; seven holes in front, one hole behind.
translations.idiomatic: The niedoujiang has a wooden tube and copper bell, flaring toward the lower end, with seven front holes and one back hole.

sentences.zh: 管端設銅哨，加蘆哨於上，管與銅口相接處，以銅簽掩之。

translations.literal: At the tube end a copper reed is set; a reed pipe is added above; where the tube and copper mouth meet, a copper plug covers it.
translations.idiomatic: A copper reed sits at the tube end with a reed pipe above; where tube meets bell a copper plug seals the joint.

sentences.zh: 聶聶兜姜，形如金口角而小，木管木口，餘與聶兜姜同。

translations.literal: Nieniedoujiang: shaped like the jin koujiao but smaller; wooden tube, wooden mouth; the rest the same as the niedoujiang.
translations.idiomatic: The nieniedoujiang resembles a smaller jin koujiao, with wooden tube and wooden bell; otherwise it matches the niedoujiang.

sentences.zh: 結莽聶兜布，范銅二片，圓徑三寸五分。

translations.literal: Jiemangniedoubu: two cast copper pieces; round diameter three cun five fen.
translations.idiomatic: The jiemangniedoubu consists of two cast copper discs three cun and five fen in diameter.

sentences.zh: 中隆起，穿孔，貫以韋，左右合擊。

translations.literal: The center is raised; holes pierced; hide cord passed through; struck together left and right.
translations.idiomatic: Domed and pierced, they are linked by a hide thong and clashed together in the hands.

sentences.zh: 細緬甸樂，用巴打拉一，蚌札一，總稿機一，密穹總一，得約總一，不壘一，接足一。

translations.literal: Fine Burmese music uses one badala, one bangzha, one zonggaoji, one miqiongong, one deyuegong, one bulei, one jiezu.
translations.idiomatic: Fine Burmese music employs one badala, one bangzha, one zonggaoji, one miqiongong, one deyuegong, one bulei, and one jiezu.

sentences.zh: 巴打拉，以木為槽，形如船，通長二尺七寸五分。

translations.literal: Badala: wood serves as the sound box; shaped like a boat; total length two chi seven cun five fen.
translations.idiomatic: The badala is a boat-shaped wooden trough two chi, seven cun, and five fen long overall.

sentences.zh: 前後兩端各為山峰形，兩峰之尖，絡以絲繩。

translations.literal: Both front and rear ends are peak-shaped; the tips of the two peaks are laced with silk cord.
translations.idiomatic: Both ends rise in peak shapes whose tips are linked by silk cord.

sentences.zh: 排穿竹板二十二片，皆闊一寸。

translations.literal: Twenty-two bamboo slats are strung in a row; all one cun wide.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-two bamboo slats, each one cun wide, are strung in sequence.

sentences.zh: 第一片長五寸二分，厚三分五釐，以次則長遞加而厚遞減，至末片則長一尺一寸五分，厚一分。

translations.literal: The first slat is length five cun two fen, thickness three fen five li; in succession length increases while thickness decreases; to the last slat length is one chi one cun five fen, thickness one fen.
translations.idiomatic: The first slat is five cun two fen long and three fen five li thick; each successive slat grows longer and thinner until the last measures one chi one cun five fen long and one fen thick.

sentences.zh: 以竹裹綿為槌擊之。

translations.literal: Bamboo wrapped with cotton serves as mallet to strike it.
translations.idiomatic: It is played with cotton-wrapped bamboo mallets.

sentences.zh: 蚌札，木匡冒革，上大下小。

translations.literal: Bangzha: wooden frame covered with hide; large above and small below.
translations.idiomatic: The bangzha is a hide-covered wooden drum, wider above and narrower below.

sentences.zh: 面徑六寸一分，底徑四寸，匡高一尺。

translations.literal: Face diameter six cun one fen; base diameter four cun; frame height one chi.
translations.idiomatic: The head measures six cun one fen across, the base four cun, and the frame one chi high.

sentences.zh: 四圍俱系韋絛，以手擊之。

translations.literal: Hide thongs are attached all around; struck with the hands.
translations.idiomatic: Hide thongs circle the frame and it is struck by hand.

sentences.zh: 總稿機，十三弦，曲柄，通槽，柄上曲如蠍尾。

translations.literal: Zonggaoji: thirteen strings; curved neck; open sound box; the neck curves like a scorpion's tail.
translations.idiomatic: The zonggaoji has thirteen strings, a curved neck, and an open trough whose neck curls like a scorpion's tail.

sentences.zh: 槽面冒革，為四圓孔以出音。

translations.literal: The sound-box face is covered with hide; four round holes are made to emit sound.
translations.idiomatic: The soundboard is hide-covered with four round sound holes.

sentences.zh: 順槽腹設覆手，穿孔十三，系弦，各斜引至柄束之，彈以手。

translations.literal: Along the sound-box belly a hand guard is set; thirteen holes pierced; strings attached; each drawn obliquely to the neck and bound; plucked with the hands.
translations.idiomatic: A hand guard runs along the belly with thirteen string holes; the strings angle up to the neck and are plucked by hand.

sentences.zh: 密穹總，三弦，木質，為魚形。

translations.literal: Miqiongong: three strings; wooden; in fish shape.
translations.idiomatic: The miqiongong is a three-string wooden instrument shaped like a fish.

sentences.zh: 體長方，腹下通長刳槽，無底，兩旁鐫鱗甲。

translations.literal: The body is rectangular; beneath the belly a trough is hollowed along its full length, open at the bottom; scales are carved on both sides.
translations.idiomatic: Its rectangular body is hollowed through the belly without a base; scales are carved on both flanks.

sentences.zh: 面設品五，為小圓孔九以出音，前四，中四，後一。

translations.literal: Five frets are set on the face; nine small round holes are made to emit sound; four front, four middle, one rear.
translations.idiomatic: The face has five frets and nine small round sound holes—four forward, four amidships, one aft.

sentences.zh: 首形銳而上出，鐫須角鉅齒圓睛，尾形亦銳。

translations.literal: The head is sharp and rises upward; whiskers, horns, saw teeth, and round eyes are carved; the tail is also sharp.
translations.idiomatic: The head rises sharp, carved with whiskers, horns, saw teeth, and round eyes; the tail tapers to a point.

sentences.zh: 項上以銅為山口，系硃弦三，尾有鐶納弦，旁穿孔，設軸，左二右一，以手彈之。

translations.literal: At the neck copper serves as the nut; three vermilion strings attached; at the tail a ring receives strings; holes pierced at the sides; pegs set; two left and one right; plucked with the hands.
translations.idiomatic: A copper nut at the neck carries three vermilion strings to a tail ring; side pegs—two left, one right—tune it for hand-plucking.

sentences.zh: 得約總，三弦，木質，中虛，如扇形，中腰兩旁灣曲向內。

translations.literal: Deyuegong: three strings; wooden; hollow within; like a fan in shape; both sides of the middle waist curve inward.
translations.idiomatic: The deyuegong is a hollow three-string wooden fan, its waist curving inward on both sides.

sentences.zh: 頸半穿孔納弦，綰以三軸，左二右一，槽末施木以系弦。

translations.literal: The neck is half-pierced to receive strings; bound with three pegs, two left and one right; wood is fitted at the sound-box end to attach strings.
translations.idiomatic: Half-pierced neck holes carry the strings, tuned by three pegs—two left, one right—with an anchor block at the trough end.

sentences.zh: 扣用木弓系馬尾八十餘莖軋之。

translations.literal: For bowing, a wooden bow strung with eighty-odd horsehair strands is drawn across it.
translations.idiomatic: It is bowed with a wooden stick strung with eighty-odd horsehair strands.

sentences.zh: 不壘，以竹為管，上端以木塞其半為吹口。

translations.literal: Bulei: bamboo serves as the tube; at the upper end wood plugs half of it as blow hole.
translations.idiomatic: The bulei is a bamboo tube whose upper end is half-plugged with wood to form the blow hole.

sentences.zh: 七孔前出，一孔後出，最上一孔前出，加竹膜。

translations.literal: Seven holes open forward, one hole opens backward, the uppermost hole opens forward; bamboo membrane is added.
translations.idiomatic: Seven front holes, one back hole, and a top front hole carry a bamboo reed membrane.

sentences.zh: 接足，范銅二片，口徑一寸八分。

translations.literal: Jiezu: two cast copper pieces; mouth diameter one cun eight fen.
translations.idiomatic: The jiezu consists of two cast copper cymbals one cun and eight fen across the mouth.

sentences.zh: 中隆起，穿孔貫紃，左右合擊。

translations.literal: The center is raised; holes pierced, cords passed through; struck together left and right.
translations.idiomatic: Domed at center and pierced for cord, they are clashed together in the hands.

sentences.zh: 乾隆五十四年，獲安南國樂，列於宴樂之末，是為安南樂舞。

translations.literal: Qianlong year 54, Annamese music was obtained, listed at the end of banquet music—this is Annamese music and dance.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-fourth year of Qianlong, when Annamese music was captured, it was placed last among the banquet music as Annamese music and dance.

sentences.zh: 用丐鼓一，丐拍一，丐哨一，丐彈弦子一，丐彈胡琴一，丐彈雙韻一，丐彈琵琶一，丐三音鑼一。

translations.literal: Uses one gey gu, one gey pai, one gey shao, one gey tan xianzi, one gey tan huqin, one gey tan shuangyun, one gey tan pipa, one gey sanyin luo.
translations.idiomatic: It employs one gey gu, gey pai, gey shao, gey tan xianzi, gey tan huqin, gey tan shuangyun, gey tan pipa, and gey sanyin luo.

sentences.zh: 安南土語，凡樂器之名，俱以丐字建首。

translations.literal: In Annamese vernacular, all instrument names begin with the character ge.
translations.idiomatic: In the Annamese tongue, every instrument name begins with ge.

sentences.zh: 丐鼓，木匡冒革，空其下，徑八寸四分，承以架。

translations.literal: Gey gu: wooden frame covered with hide; the underside hollowed; diameter eight cun four fen; supported on a stand.
translations.idiomatic: The gey gu is a hide drum eight cun and four fen across, open beneath and set on a stand.

sentences.zh: 用竹桴二，或左手承鼓，右手以桴擊之。

translations.literal: Two bamboo mallets are used; or the left hand holds the drum while the right hand strikes with a mallet.
translations.idiomatic: It is played with two bamboo sticks, or held in the left hand and struck with the right.

sentences.zh: 丐拍，用檀板三：其一上端綴以連錢。

translations.literal: Gey pai: three sandalwood clappers are used; on one the upper end is adorned with linked coins.
translations.idiomatic: The gey pai uses three sandalwood clappers, one with linked coins at the top.

sentences.zh: 其一背刻雁齒，其一右為鋸牙。

translations.literal: On one the back is carved with wild-goose teeth; on one the right edge is saw-toothed.
translations.idiomatic: One is back-carved with a sawtooth ridge; another is serrated on the right edge.

sentences.zh: 左手執二板相擊，連錢激響，右手執鋸牙者，引擊雁齒，錯落成聲。

translations.literal: The left hand holds two boards and strikes them together; the linked coins ring out; the right hand holds the saw-tooth one and draws it against the wild-goose-teeth board, producing staggered sounds.
translations.idiomatic: The left hand claps two boards so the coins ring; the right hand draws the serrated slat across the ridged one for cascading tones.

sentences.zh: 丐哨，即橫笛，截竹為筒，漆飾，二十一節。

translations.literal: Gey shao: that is, the horizontal flute; bamboo cut into a tube; lacquer ornament; twenty-one nodes.
translations.idiomatic: The gey shao is a transverse flute of lacquered bamboo with twenty-one nodes.

sentences.zh: 左第一孔為吹口，次加竹膜，右六孔，末二孔，俱上出，旁二孔對出，兩端飾以角。

translations.literal: The first hole at the left is the blow hole; next a bamboo membrane is added; six holes to the right; the last two holes, all open upward; two side holes open opposite each other; both ends ornamented with horn.
translations.idiomatic: The leftmost hole is the embouchure, followed by a reed membrane; six right-hand holes, two end holes opening upward, and two opposite side holes; both ends are capped in horn.

sentences.zh: 丐彈弦子，三弦，斫檀為質，槽方而橢，兩面冒虺皮。

translations.literal: Gey tan xianzi: three strings; sandalwood carved for the body; sound box square and oval; both faces covered with python hide.
translations.idiomatic: The gey tan xianzi is a three-string sandalwood instrument with an oval-square body covered in python hide on both faces.

sentences.zh: 匙頭鑿空納弦，以三軸綰之，左二右一。

translations.literal: The spoon-shaped head is hollowed to receive strings; bound with three pegs, two left and one right.
translations.idiomatic: The spoon-shaped head is hollowed for the strings, secured by three pegs—two left, one right.

sentences.zh: 丐彈胡琴，二弦，竹柄，槽形如筒，底微豐，面冒虺皮。

translations.literal: Gey tan huqin: two strings; bamboo neck; sound box tube-shaped; base slightly full; face covered with python hide.
translations.idiomatic: The gey tan huqin has two strings, a bamboo neck, a slightly rounded tubular body, and a python-hide face.

sentences.zh: 曲首鑿空，兩軸俱自後穿前綰弦，弦自山口至柱，長一尺八寸，餘如番部合樂胡琴之制。

translations.literal: The curved head is hollowed; both pegs pass from back to front to bind strings; strings from nut to bridge, length one chi eight cun; the rest like the frontier ensemble huqin in construction.
translations.idiomatic: The curved head is hollowed; both pegs thread frontward from the back; the strings measure one chi eight cun from nut to bridge; otherwise it follows the frontier-ensemble huqin.

sentences.zh: 丐彈雙韻，如月琴，四弦，斫檀為質，槽面以桐，形如滿月。

translations.literal: Gey tan shuangyun: like the yueqin; four strings; sandalwood carved for the body; paulownia for the sound-box face; shaped like the full moon.
translations.idiomatic: The gey tan shuangyun resembles the yueqin—a four-string sandalwood moon lute with a paulownia face.

sentences.zh: 徑一尺一寸六分，厚一寸八分。

translations.literal: Diameter one chi one cun six fen; thickness one cun eight fen.
translations.idiomatic: It is one chi one cun six fen across and one cun eight fen thick.

sentences.zh: 曲項鑿空納弦，綰以四軸，左右各二。

translations.literal: The curved neck is hollowed to receive strings; bound with four pegs, two left and two right.
translations.idiomatic: The curved neck is hollowed for the strings, tuned by four pegs—two on each side.

sentences.zh: 槽面覆手，山口下七品，俱以檀為之。

translations.literal: A hand guard on the sound-box face; seven frets below the nut; all made of sandalwood.
translations.idiomatic: A hand guard caps the face, with seven sandalwood frets below the nut.

sentences.zh: 丐彈琵琶，四弦，刳桐為質，通長三尺。

translations.literal: Gey tan pipa: four strings; paulownia hollowed for the body; total length three chi.
translations.idiomatic: The gey tan pipa is a four-string paulownia lute three chi long overall.

sentences.zh: 項上鑿空納弦，綰以四軸，左右各二。

translations.literal: At the neck hollowed to receive strings; bound with four pegs, two left and two right.
translations.idiomatic: The neck is hollowed for the strings and secured by four pegs—two on each side.

sentences.zh: 上設四象，下布十品。

translations.literal: Four elephant-shaped pieces are set above; ten frets arranged below.
translations.idiomatic: Four elephant-shaped nut pieces sit above, with ten frets below.

sentences.zh: 弦自山口至覆手，長二尺一寸四分。

translations.literal: Strings from nut to hand guard, length two chi one cun four fen.
translations.idiomatic: The strings span two chi one cun and four fen from nut to hand guard.

sentences.zh: 丐三音鑼，范銅，三面，綰以鐵圈，聯如品字。

translations.literal: Gey sanyin luo: cast copper; three faces; bound with iron rings; joined in the shape of the character pin.
translations.idiomatic: The gey sanyin luo is three cast-copper gongs linked by iron rings in a pin-shaped cluster.

sentences.zh: 上一徑二寸四分五釐，右一徑二寸三分八釐，左一徑二寸三分。

translations.literal: The upper one, diameter two cun four fen five li; the right one, diameter two cun three fen eight li; the left one, diameter two cun three fen.
translations.idiomatic: The top gong is two cun four fen five li across; the right two cun three fen eight li; the left two cun three fen.

sentences.zh: 承以檀柄，槌用角。

translations.literal: Supported on sandalwood handles; mallets use horn.
translations.idiomatic: Each rests on a sandalwood handle and is struck with horn mallets.

sentences.zh: 賜宴樂，凡經筵禮畢賜宴，文、武鄉、會試賜宴，宴衍聖公，宴正一真人皆用之。

translations.literal: Imperial Gift Banquet Music: whenever the Classics Colloquium concludes with an imperial banquet, civil and military provincial and metropolitan examination banquets, banquets for the Duke of Yansheng, and banquets for the Zhengyi True Man—all use it.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial Gift Banquet Music accompanies the post-colloquium imperial feast, the civil and military examination banquets, banquets for the Duke of Yansheng, and banquets for the Zhengyi True Man.

sentences.zh: 其器：雲鑼二，笛二，管二，笙二，鼓一，拍板一。

translations.literal: Its instruments: two cloud gongs, two di flutes, two guan pipes, two sheng mouth-organs, one drum, one clapper board.
translations.idiomatic: Its ensemble comprises two cloud gongs, two di flutes, two guan pipes, two sheng mouth-organs, one drum, and clapper boards.

sentences.zh: 笛、笙、鼓同中和韶樂，雲鑼、管、板同丹陛大樂。

translations.literal: Di, sheng, and drum are the same as Zhonghe Shao Music; cloud gongs, guan, and clappers are the same as Danbi Grand Music.
translations.idiomatic: The di, sheng, and drum match those of Zhonghe Shao Music; the cloud gongs, guan, and clappers match Danbi Grand Music.

sentences.zh: 鄉樂，凡府、州、縣學春、秋釋奠皆用之。

translations.literal: Village Music: whenever district, prefectural, and county schools perform spring and autumn libation sacrifices, all use it.
translations.idiomatic: Village Music is used for the spring and autumn sacrificial ceremonies at prefectural, departmental, and county schools.

sentences.zh: 其器麾一，編鐘十六，編磬十六，琴六，瑟二，排簫二，簫四，笛六，篪二，笙六，塤二，建鼓一，搏拊二，柷一，敔一。

translations.literal: Its instruments: one baton, sixteen serial bells, sixteen serial chimes, six qin, two se, two panpipes, four xiao, six di, two chi, six sheng, two xun, one set-up drum, two hand clappers, one zhù, one yù.
translations.idiomatic: Its ensemble includes one conductor's baton, sixteen serial bells and chimes, six qin and two se, two panpipes, four xiao, six di, two chi, six sheng, two xun ocarinas, one set-up drum, two hand clappers, a zhù, and a yù.

sentences.zh: 制皆同中和韶樂。

translations.literal: Construction all the same as Zhonghe Shao Music.
translations.idiomatic: All are constructed like those of Zhonghe Shao Music.

sentences.zh: 鄉飲酒用雲鑼一，方響一，琴二，瑟一，簫四，笛四，笙四，手鼓一，拍板一。

translations.literal: Village drinking ceremony uses one cloud gong, one square sounding stone, two qin, one se, four xiao, four di, four sheng, one hand drum, one clapper board.
translations.idiomatic: The village drinking rite employs one cloud gong, one square sounding stone, two qin, one se, four xiao, four di, four sheng, one hand drum, and clapper boards.

sentences.zh: 琴、瑟、簫、笛、笙同中和韶樂，雲鑼、方響、板同丹陛大樂，手鼓同清樂。

translations.literal: Qin, se, xiao, di, and sheng are the same as Zhonghe Shao Music; cloud gongs, square sounding stone, and clappers are the same as Danbi Grand Music; hand drum is the same as Qing Music.
translations.idiomatic: The qin, se, xiao, di, and sheng match Zhonghe Shao Music; the cloud gong, square sounding stone, and clappers match Danbi Grand Music; the hand drum matches Qing Music.

sentences.zh: 節，中和韶樂用。

translations.literal: Jie: used in Zhonghe Shao Music.
translations.idiomatic: The jie dance baton is used in Zhonghe Shao Music.

sentences.zh: 結旄九重，蓋以金葉，束以綠皮。

translations.literal: Yak tails are tied in nine layers; covered with gold leaf; bound with green leather.
translations.idiomatic: Nine tiers of yak-tail tassels are capped with gold leaf and bound with green leather.

sentences.zh: 硃杠，上曲為龍首以銜旄。

translations.literal: A vermilion pole; above curving into a dragon head to hold the tails in its mouth.
translations.idiomatic: A vermilion staff curves into a dragon head that holds the tassels in its jaws.

sentences.zh: 植架於東西各一，每架二節，司樂者執之以節舞。

translations.literal: Stands are planted east and west, one each; on each stand two jie; the music officers hold them to mark the dance.
translations.idiomatic: One stand is set to the east and one to the west, each bearing two batons that the music officers wield to lead the dance.

sentences.zh: 導文舞曰節，導武舞曰旌，旌亦曰節，制與節同。

translations.literal: That which leads civil dance is called jie; that which leads military dance is called jing; jing is also called jie; construction the same as jie.
translations.idiomatic: The baton that leads civil dance is called jie; that for military dance is called jing—also termed jie—and is made the same way.

sentences.zh: 千，中和韶樂用。

translations.literal: Gan: used in Zhonghe Shao Music.
translations.idiomatic: The gan shield is used in Zhonghe Shao Music.

sentences.zh: 木質，圭首，上半繪五采雲龍，下繪交龍，緣以五色羽文。

translations.literal: Wooden; with scepter-shaped top; the upper half painted with five-colored cloud-and-dragon; the lower painted with interlaced dragons; the edge with five-colored feather patterns.
translations.idiomatic: It is wooden with a scepter-shaped head; the upper half shows polychrome cloud-dragons, the lower interlaced dragons, trimmed with five-colored feather motifs.

sentences.zh: 中為粉地，硃書「雨暘時若，四海永清。

translations.literal: The middle is a white ground; vermilion inscription: "When rain and sunshine are timely, the four seas are forever clear.
translations.idiomatic: On a white ground in vermilion runs: "When rain and sunshine come in season, the four seas abide in peace.

sentences.zh: 倉箱大有，八方敉寧。

translations.literal: Granaries and bins overflow; the eight directions are pacified and at rest.
translations.idiomatic: Granaries brim full; the eight directions rest in calm.

sentences.zh: 奉三永奠，得一為正，百神受職，萬國來庭」。

translations.literal: Offer the three permanences in everlasting sacrifice; hold the One as the standard; the hundred spirits receive their offices; the myriad states come to court."
translations.idiomatic: Offer the three eternal sacrifices; take the One as standard; the hundred spirits assume their offices; the myriad states come to court."

sentences.zh: 凡八語，佾各一語。

translations.literal: Eight phrases in all; each row-dancer one phrase.
translations.idiomatic: Eight lines in all—one for each row of dancers.

sentences.zh: 干背魨硃，有橫帶二，中施曲木，武舞生左手執之。

translations.literal: The back of the gan lacquered vermilion; two horizontal bands; curved wood fitted in the middle; martial dancers hold it in the left hand.
translations.idiomatic: Its back is lacquered vermilion with two horizontal bands and a curved wood grip; martial dancers hold it in the left hand.

sentences.zh: 戚，中和韶樂用。

translations.literal: Qi: used in Zhonghe Shao Music.
translations.idiomatic: The qi axe is used in Zhonghe Shao Music.

sentences.zh: 木質，斧形，背黑刃白，柄魨硃，武舞生右手執之。

translations.literal: Wooden; axe-shaped; back black, blade white; handle lacquered vermilion; martial dancers hold it in the right hand.
translations.idiomatic: It is wooden and axe-shaped, black-backed with a white blade and vermilion handle; martial dancers grip it in the right hand.

sentences.zh: 羽，中和韶樂用。

translations.literal: Yu: used in Zhonghe Shao Music.
translations.idiomatic: The yu plumes are used in Zhonghe Shao Music.

sentences.zh: 木柄，植雉羽，銜以塗金龍首，柄魨硃，文舞生右手執之。

translations.literal: Wooden handle; pheasant feathers planted; held in a gilded dragon head; handle lacquered vermilion; civil dancers hold it in the right hand.
translations.idiomatic: A wooden shaft bears pheasant plumes in a gilded dragon head, the handle lacquered vermilion; civil dancers hold it in the right hand.

sentences.zh: 籥，中和韶樂用。

translations.literal: Yue: used in Zhonghe Shao Music.
translations.idiomatic: The yue flute is used in Zhonghe Shao Music.

sentences.zh: 六孔竹管，魨硃，文舞生左手執之。

translations.literal: Six-hole bamboo tube; lacquered vermilion; civil dancers hold it in the left hand.
translations.idiomatic: A six-holed bamboo pipe lacquered vermilion; civil dancers hold it in the left hand.

sentences.zh: 舞有二：用於祀神者曰佾舞，用於宴饗者曰隊舞。

translations.literal: Dance has two types: that used to sacrifice to the spirits is called row dance; that used at banquets is called team dance.
translations.idiomatic: Dance falls into two kinds—row dance for spirit sacrifice, team dance for feasts.

sentences.zh: 凡佾舞武用干戚，文用羽籥。

translations.literal: In general, row dance martial uses gan and qi; civil uses yu and yue.
translations.idiomatic: In row dance, martial performers use shield and axe; civil performers use plumes and pipe.

sentences.zh: 干戚曰武功之舞，羽籥曰文德之舞，祭祀初獻以武舞，亞獻終獻以文舞，惟先師廟、文昌廟初獻、亞獻、終獻皆以文舞焉。

translations.literal: Gan and qi are called martial merit dance; yu and yue are called civil virtue dance; at sacrifices the first offering uses martial dance, the second and third offerings use civil dance; only at the Former Master Temple and Wenchang Temple are first, second, and third offerings all civil dance.
translations.idiomatic: Shield and axe mark the martial dance; plumes and pipe mark the civil dance. Sacrifices open with martial dance and continue with civil dance at the second and third offerings—except at the temples of the Former Master and Wenchang, where all three offerings use civil dance alone.

sentences.zh: 若大雩，則童子十六人衣皁衣，持羽翳，歌而舞皇舞，凡此皆隸於佾舞者也。

translations.literal: For the Great Supplication for Rain, sixteen boys wear black robes, hold feather screens, sing and perform the Imperial Dance—all these belong to the row dance.
translations.idiomatic: For the Great Supplication for Rain, sixteen boys in black robes hold feather screens and sing while performing the Imperial Dance—all of these fall under row dance.

sentences.zh: 隸於隊舞者，初名蟒式舞，亦曰瑪克式舞。

translations.literal: Those belonging to team dance were originally called Python-style Dance, also called Mark-style Dance.
translations.idiomatic: Team dance was originally called Python-style Dance, also known as Mark-style Dance.

sentences.zh: 乾隆八年，更名慶隆舞，內分大、小馬護為揚烈舞，是為武舞，大臣起舞上壽為喜起舞，是為文舞。

translations.literal: In Qianlong year 8 it was renamed Celebratory Prosperity Dance; within it, large and small horse guardians form the Fierce Display Dance—this is martial dance; ministers rising to dance and offer longevity wishes form the Joyous Rising Dance—this is civil dance.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 8 it was renamed Celebratory Prosperity Dance. The large and small horse-guardian segments became the Fierce Display Dance—the martial dance—while ministers rising to dance and offer birthday wishes formed the Joyous Rising Dance—the civil dance.

sentences.zh: 是年巡幸盛京，筵宴宗室，增世德舞。

translations.literal: That year on an imperial tour to Shengjing, a banquet was held for the imperial clan and the Worldly Virtue Dance was added.
translations.idiomatic: That same year, during an imperial tour to Shengjing, a clan banquet added the Worldly Virtue Dance.

sentences.zh: 十四年，平定金川，凱旋筵宴，又增德勝舞，三舞同制，各有樂章。

translations.literal: In year 14, Jinchuan was pacified; at the triumphal banquet the Virtuous Victory Dance was added; the three dances share the same form, each with its own musical text.
translations.idiomatic: In year 14, after the pacification of Jinchuan, the triumphal banquet added the Virtuous Victory Dance. All three dances follow the same format, each with its own libretto.

sentences.zh: 揚烈舞，用戴面具三十二人，衣黃畫布者半，衣黑羊皮者半。

translations.literal: The Fierce Display Dance uses thirty-two masked performers; half wear yellow painted cloth, half wear black sheepskin.
translations.idiomatic: The Fierce Display Dance employs thirty-two masked dancers—half in yellow painted cloth, half in black sheepskin.

sentences.zh: 跳躍倒擲，象異獸。

translations.literal: Leaping and tumbling, imitating strange beasts.
translations.idiomatic: They leap and tumble, mimicking strange beasts.

sentences.zh: 騎禺馬者八人，介胄弓矢，分兩翼上，北面一叩，興。

translations.literal: Eight riders on hobbyhorses, in armor with bows and arrows, advance in two wings; facing north they bow once and rise.
translations.idiomatic: Eight riders on hobbyhorses, armored and bearing bows and arrows, advance in two wings; facing north they bow once and rise.

sentences.zh: 周旋馳逐，象八旗。

translations.literal: Wheeling and charging, imitating the Eight Banners.
translations.idiomatic: They wheel and charge, representing the Eight Banners.

sentences.zh: 一獸受矢，群獸懾伏，象武成。

translations.literal: One beast receives the arrow; the herd of beasts cower in submission, imitating the completion of martial achievement.
translations.idiomatic: One beast takes the arrow; the rest cower in submission—symbolizing the completion of victory.

sentences.zh: 喜起舞，大臣二十二人，朝服儀刀入，三叩，興，退東位西鄉立。

translations.literal: The Joyous Rising Dance: twenty-two ministers enter in court dress with ceremonial swords; three bows, rise, withdraw to the east and stand facing west.
translations.idiomatic: In the Joyous Rising Dance, twenty-two ministers enter in court dress bearing ceremonial swords; they bow three times, rise, withdraw to the east, and stand facing west.

sentences.zh: 以兩而進，舞畢三叩，退。

translations.literal: Advancing two at a time; when the dance is finished, three bows and withdraw.
translations.idiomatic: They advance two at a time; when the dance ends they bow three times and withdraw.

sentences.zh: 次隊繼進如前儀。

translations.literal: The next pair follows in the same ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: Each subsequent pair follows in the same manner.

sentences.zh: 此隊舞之大較也。

translations.literal: This is the general outline of team dance.
translations.idiomatic: Such is the general outline of team dance.

sentences.zh: 外此則有四裔樂舞：東曰瓦爾喀、曰朝鮮，北曰蒙古，西曰回、曰番、曰廓爾喀，南曰緬甸、曰安南，皆同列於宴樂之末。

translations.literal: Beyond this are music and dance of the four frontiers: in the east, Uriankhai and Korea; in the north, Mongolia; in the west, Muslim, Tibetan, and Gurkha; in the south, Burma and Annam—all likewise placed last among the banquet music.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond these are the music and dances of the four frontiers—Uriankhai and Korea in the east, Mongolia in the north, Muslim, Tibetan, and Gurkha in the west, Burma and Annam in the south—all placed last among the banquet music.

sentences.zh: 瓦爾喀部樂舞，司舞八人，均服紅雲緞鑲壯緞花補袍，狐皮大帽，豫立丹陛之西。

translations.literal: Uriankhai music and dance: eight dancers, all wearing red cloud-satin robes with bold-satin flower patches, fox-fur caps; pre-positioned west of the cinnabar steps.
translations.idiomatic: Uriankhai music and dance employs eight dancers in red cloud-satin robes with bold-satin flower patches and fox-fur caps, pre-positioned west of the cinnabar steps.

sentences.zh: 將作樂，進前三叩，退。

translations.literal: When music is about to begin, advance three steps, bow three times, withdraw.
translations.idiomatic: Before the music begins, they advance three steps, bow three times, and withdraw.

sentences.zh: 司樂八人，分兩翼上，跪一膝，奏瓦爾喀樂曲。

translations.literal: Eight musicians advance in two wings, kneel on one knee, and perform Uriankhai musical pieces.
translations.idiomatic: Eight musicians advance in two wings, kneel on one knee, and play Uriankhai pieces.

sentences.zh: 司舞進舞，以兩為隊，每隊舞畢，三叩，退。

translations.literal: The dancers advance to dance, two as a team; when each team finishes dancing, three bows and withdraw.
translations.idiomatic: The dancers perform in pairs; when each pair finishes, they bow three times and withdraw.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮國俳，笛技、管技、鼓技各一人，均戴氈帽，鏤金頂，服藍雲緞袍，椶色雲緞背心，藍綢帶。

translations.literal: The Korean troupe: one di specialist, one guan specialist, one drum specialist; all wear felt caps with gilded tops, blue cloud-satin robes, palm-colored cloud-satin vests, and blue silk sashes.
translations.idiomatic: The Korean troupe includes one di specialist, one guan specialist, and one drum specialist—all in felt caps with gilded tops, blue cloud-satin robes, palm-colored cloud-satin vests, and blue silk sashes.

sentences.zh: 俳長一人，戴面具，青緞帽，紅纓，服紅雲緞袍，白綢長袖綠雲緞虎補背心，十字藍綢帶。
