translations.literal: One troupe leader wears a mask, blue satin cap with red tassel, red cloud-satin robe, white-silk long sleeves, green cloud-satin tiger-patch vest, and cross-shaped blue silk sash.
translations.idiomatic: The troupe leader wears a mask, a blue satin cap with a red tassel, a red cloud-satin robe, white silk sleeves, a green cloud-satin tiger-patch vest, and a cross-shaped blue silk sash.

sentences.zh: 倒擲技十四人，服短紅衣。

translations.literal: Fourteen tumbling performers wear short red garments.
translations.idiomatic: Fourteen tumbling performers wear short red jackets.

sentences.zh: 立丹陛兩旁。

translations.literal: Stand on both sides of the cinnabar steps.
translations.idiomatic: They stand on either side of the cinnabar steps.

sentences.zh: 俳長從右翼上，北面立，以高麗語致辭，笛、管、鼓技從右翼上，東北面立，倒擲技從左翼上，自東向西，各呈其藝。

translations.literal: The troupe leader ascends from the right wing, stands facing north, and delivers an address in Korean; the di, guan, and drum specialists ascend from the right wing and stand facing northeast; the tumbling performers ascend from the left wing, from east to west, each displaying their art.
translations.idiomatic: The troupe leader enters from the right wing, faces north, and delivers an address in Korean. The di, guan, and drum specialists enter from the right and stand facing northeast; the tumblers enter from the left, moving east to west, each displaying their skill.

sentences.zh: 蒙古樂，笳吹，司樂器四人，司章四人，均蟒服，立丹陛旁。

translations.literal: Mongol music, reed-pipe blowing: four musicians, four banner-bearers, all in python-pattern robes, stand beside the cinnabar steps.
translations.idiomatic: Mongol reed-pipe music employs four musicians and four banner-bearers, all in python-pattern robes, standing beside the cinnabar steps.

sentences.zh: 番部合奏，司樂器十五人，亦均蟒服，立丹陛旁，與笳吹一班同入。

translations.literal: Frontier ensemble: fifteen musicians, also all in python-pattern robes, stand beside the cinnabar steps and enter together with the reed-pipe group.
translations.idiomatic: The frontier ensemble comprises fifteen musicians, likewise in python-pattern robes, standing beside the cinnabar steps and entering together with the reed-pipe group.

sentences.zh: 一叩，跪一膝，奏蒙古樂曲。

translations.literal: One bow, kneel on one knee, perform Mongol musical pieces.
translations.idiomatic: They bow once, kneel on one knee, and play Mongol pieces.

sentences.zh: 回部樂，司樂器八人，均錦衣絹里雜色紡絲接袖衣，錦面布里倭緞緣回回帽，青緞鞾，綠綢荅膊。

translations.literal: Muslim music: eight musicians, all in brocade outer robes with silk lining, multicolored spun-silk joined-sleeve garments, brocade-faced cloth-lined caps with Japanese-satin trim, blue satin boots, and green silk arm guards.
translations.idiomatic: Muslim music employs eight musicians in brocade outer robes with silk lining, multicolored spun-silk joined-sleeve garments, brocade-faced caps with Japanese-satin trim, blue satin boots, and green silk arm guards.

sentences.zh: 司舞二人，舞盤二人，皆衣靠子錦腰襴紡絲接袖衣。

translations.literal: Two dancers and two plate-dancers all wear tight-fitting brocade waist-apron spun-silk joined-sleeve garments.
translations.idiomatic: Two dancers and two plate-dancers all wear tight-fitting brocade waist-apron spun-silk joined-sleeve garments.

sentences.zh: 倒擲大回子四人，皆衣靠子雜色紡絲接袖衣，戴五色綢回回小帽。

translations.literal: Four large Muslim tumblers all wear tight-fitting multicolored spun-silk joined-sleeve garments and five-colored silk Muslim caps.
translations.idiomatic: Four senior Muslim tumblers wear tight-fitting multicolored spun-silk joined-sleeve garments and five-colored silk Muslim caps.

sentences.zh: 小回子二人，雜色綢衣絹里。

translations.literal: Two junior Muslims wear multicolored silk garments with silk lining.
translations.idiomatic: Two junior Muslim performers wear multicolored silk garments with silk lining.

sentences.zh: 皆豫立丹陛下，俟朝鮮國俳呈技後，上丹陛作樂。

translations.literal: All are pre-positioned below the cinnabar steps; after the Korean troupe displays its skills, they ascend the cinnabar steps and perform music.
translations.idiomatic: All are pre-positioned below the cinnabar steps; after the Korean troupe finishes, they ascend the steps and perform.

sentences.zh: 司舞起舞，舞盤人隨舞。

translations.literal: The dancers begin to dance; the plate-dancers dance along.
translations.idiomatic: The dancers perform, and the plate-dancers join them.

sentences.zh: 畢，倒擲小回子繼進呈技。

translations.literal: When finished, the junior Muslim tumblers follow to display their skills.
translations.idiomatic: When they finish, the junior Muslim tumblers follow to display their skills.

sentences.zh: 番子樂，金川之阿爾薩蘭，司樂器三人，司舞三人，為戲獅，身長七尺，披五色毛，番名僧格乙，引獅者衣雜采，手執繩，系耍球一，五色，番名僧格乙阿拉喀。

translations.literal: Tibetan music, Jinchuan Arsalan: three musicians, three dancers perform a lion play; the lion is seven chi tall, draped in five-colored fur, Tibetan name Sengge Yi; the lion-leader wears multicolored garments, holds a rope attached to a five-colored trick ball, Tibetan name Sengge Yi Alaka.
translations.idiomatic: Tibetan music—Jinchuan Arsalan—employs three musicians and three dancers in a lion play. The lion stands seven chi tall, draped in five-colored fur (Tibetan: Sengge Yi). The lion-leader wears multicolored garments and holds a rope tied to a five-colored trick ball (Tibetan: Sengge Yi Alaka).

sentences.zh: 大郭庄，番名大拉噶地，司舞十人，每兩人相攜而舞，一服蟒服，戴翎，掛珠，斜披黃藍二帶，交如十字；

translations.literal: Daguzhuang, Tibetan name Dalagadi: ten dancers, each pair dancing together; one wears python-pattern robe, plumes, prayer beads, and yellow and blue sashes crossed like a cross;
translations.idiomatic: Daguzhuang (Tibetan: Dalagadi) employs ten dancers in pairs. One partner wears a python-pattern robe, plumes, prayer beads, and yellow and blue sashes crossed in an X;

sentences.zh: 一服藍袍，掛珠，斜披黃紫二帶，交如十字。

translations.literal: One wears blue robe, prayer beads, and yellow and purple sashes crossed like a cross.
translations.idiomatic: the other wears a blue robe, prayer beads, and yellow and purple sashes crossed in an X.

sentences.zh: 四角魯，番名得勒布，司舞六人，戴舞盔，番名達帽。

translations.literal: Sijiaolu, Tibetan name Delebu: six dancers wear dance helmets, Tibetan name Damao.
translations.idiomatic: Sijiaolu (Tibetan: Delebu) employs six dancers wearing dance helmets (Tibetan: Damao).

sentences.zh: 插雞翎各六，番名達莫乙。

translations.literal: Each inserts six pheasant plumes, Tibetan name Damoyi.
translations.idiomatic: Each bears six pheasant plumes (Tibetan: Damoyi).

sentences.zh: 背縛藤牌，番名賽斯丹。

translations.literal: Rattan shields bound on the back, Tibetan name Saisidan.
translations.idiomatic: Rattan shields are strapped to their backs (Tibetan: Saisidan).

sentences.zh: 帶系腰刀，番名江格乙。

translations.literal: Waist knives tied at the belt, Tibetan name Jiangge Yi.
translations.idiomatic: Waist knives hang from their belts (Tibetan: Jiangge Yi).

sentences.zh: 左執弓，番名得木尼也。

translations.literal: Left hand holds bow, Tibetan name Demuniye.
translations.idiomatic: They hold bows in the left hand (Tibetan: Demuniye).

sentences.zh: 右執箭壺，番名柏拉。

translations.literal: Right hand holds quiver, Tibetan name Bola.
translations.idiomatic: Quivers are held in the right hand, Tibetan name Bola.

sentences.zh: 盛箭五枝，番名格必乙。

translations.literal: Holding five arrows, Tibetan name Gebiyi.
translations.idiomatic: Each quiver holds five arrows (Tibetan: Gebiyi).

sentences.zh: 相對而舞。

translations.literal: Dancing facing each other.
translations.idiomatic: They dance facing one another.

sentences.zh: 班禪之札什倫布，番名柏拉噶，司樂器六人，司舞番童十人，各披長帶，手執斧一，番名沙勒鱉。

translations.literal: Panchen Tashilhunpo, Tibetan name Bolaga: six musicians, ten Tibetan boy dancers, each draped with long sashes, holding one axe, Tibetan name Shalebie.
translations.idiomatic: Panchen Tashilhunpo (Tibetan: Bolaga) employs six musicians and ten Tibetan boy dancers, each draped with long sashes and holding an axe (Tibetan: Shalebie).

sentences.zh: 舞而歌梵曲。

translations.literal: Dancing while singing Sanskrit hymns.
translations.idiomatic: They dance while singing Sanskrit hymns.

sentences.zh: 廓爾喀樂舞，司樂器六人，均衣回子衣，著紅羊皮鞾，內二人纏頭以洋錦，餘皆以紅綠布。

translations.literal: Gurkha music and dance: six musicians, all in Muslim-style garments and red sheepskin boots; two wrap their heads in foreign brocade, the rest in red and green cloth.
translations.idiomatic: Gurkha music and dance employs six musicians in Muslim-style garments and red sheepskin boots—two with foreign brocade head wraps, the rest in red and green cloth.

sentences.zh: 司歌五人，均以紅綠布纏頭，內一人衣綠綢衣，著紅采履，餘皆回子衣、紅羊皮鞾。

translations.literal: Five singers, all with red and green cloth head wraps; one wears green silk garment and red colored shoes; the rest wear Muslim-style garments and red sheepskin boots.
translations.idiomatic: Five singers, all with red and green cloth head wraps—one in a green silk garment and red colored shoes, the rest in Muslim-style garments and red sheepskin boots.

sentences.zh: 司舞二人，均衣紅綠綢衣，戴猩紅氈帽，金銀絲巾，著紅采履，束腰皆用雜色布。

translations.literal: Two dancers, both in red and green silk garments, scarlet felt caps, gold and silver thread scarves, red colored shoes, waists bound with multicolored cloth.
translations.idiomatic: Two dancers wear red and green silk garments, scarlet felt caps, gold-and-silver thread scarves, and red colored shoes, with multicolored cloth sashes at the waist.

sentences.zh: 舞者每足各系銅鈴一串，曰公古哩，騰躍出聲，歌舞並奏。

translations.literal: Each dancer's foot is tied with a string of copper bells called gonguli; leaping produces sound; song and dance are performed together.
translations.idiomatic: Each dancer wears a string of copper bells called gonguli on each foot—the bells ring as they leap, and song and dance are performed together.

sentences.zh: 粗緬甸樂，司樂器五人，司歌六人，均拖發扎紅，用緬甸衣冠。

translations.literal: Coarse Burmese music: five musicians, six singers, all with hair worn loose and tied with red, in Burmese dress.
translations.idiomatic: Coarse Burmese music employs five musicians and six singers, all with loose hair tied with red, in Burmese dress.

sentences.zh: 細緬甸樂，司樂器七人，均拖發扎紅，衣藍緞短衣。

translations.literal: Fine Burmese music: seven musicians, all with hair worn loose and tied with red, wearing blue satin short jackets.
translations.idiomatic: Fine Burmese music employs seven musicians with loose hair tied with red, wearing blue satin short jackets.

sentences.zh: 司舞四人，衣閃緞短衣，皆雜色裙，以洋錦束腰，戴扎巾。

translations.literal: Four dancers wear shimmering satin short jackets, all with multicolored skirts, waists bound with foreign brocade, wearing head wraps.
translations.idiomatic: Four dancers wear shimmering satin short jackets and multicolored skirts, with foreign brocade sashes and head wraps.

sentences.zh: 歌合以粗樂，舞合以細樂。

translations.literal: Singing is accompanied by coarse music; dancing by fine music.
translations.idiomatic: Singing is accompanied by the coarse ensemble; dancing by the fine ensemble.

sentences.zh: 安南國樂，司樂器九人，均戴道巾，衣黃鸝補服道袍，藍緞帶。

translations.literal: Annamese music: nine musicians, all wearing Daoist caps, yellow-oriole-patch Daoist robes, and blue satin sashes.
translations.idiomatic: Annamese music employs nine musicians in Daoist caps, yellow-oriole-patch Daoist robes, and blue satin sashes.

sentences.zh: 司舞四人，衣蟒衣，冠帶與司器同。

translations.literal: Four dancers wear python-pattern robes; caps and sashes same as the musicians.
translations.idiomatic: Four dancers wear python-pattern robes with the same caps and sashes as the musicians.

sentences.zh: 執采扇而舞。

translations.literal: Hold colored fans and dance.
translations.idiomatic: They dance holding colored fans.
